author: GrantInPhoenix
body:
Hey There! Been watching movies 300 and 300: Rise of an Empire and i recently
got back from a trip from my Uncle's Resort up in the north and the setting of the resort
was based off a greek style, w/ the white and blue signifying colors of Athens,
Now i had this Idea for a new map where it has the following concept

- CTW map
- Greek-based map terrain
(1 Huge Valley Map surrounding all sides w/ a Lake in the middle containing small ships and the center of the lake having
a massive general's ship w/ inside filled w/ chests full of tier 3 items and enchanting table)
- Map Size around 200by200 in all directions (Circle) 1 big piece of land over a void
- Main Spawn Building 3 rooms, ground floor/spawn room, 2nd floor/Iron Blocks, Top Floor/Wool room w/ Enchanting Table which only other opposing teams can enter and can steal the enchanting table as well.
- Map's Main Blocks (Grass, Dirt, Gravel, Stone, Wood, Quartz/ Stone Brick)
- 4 Teams/Cities
-- Red / Sparta
-- Yellow / Arcadia
-- Green / Olympia
-- Blue / Athens
- Objective: complete the monument in your team's base by capturing the wool's of the other 3 opposing Cities
which is located on the top floor of each opposing team's spawn building

Starting Kit:
- Stone Sword
- Bow (Infinity I) and 1 arrow
- Full Leather (Dyed to each teams color)
- 3 Golden Apples (kills won't give you golden apples to reduce chances of snowballing for gapples, so when you kill someone
for gapples, they will drop golden apples if ever they have any in their inventory, if they don't you still don't get a gapple from the kill)
- 64 Cooked Beef/Steak
- Diamond Pickaxe
- Iron Axe
- 32 Acacia Logs
- 64 Cobblestone
- 4 XP Bottles

This is pretty much all i have for now, any suggestions and comments are open down below!
